author: sjm41
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
IPR022674
Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase, NAD-binding

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Fly G6pdl (FBgn0037147)

* **Description of issue**
Fly G6pdl (FBgn0037147) is annotated as a pseudo enzyme, but gets '[oxidoreductase activity, acting on CH-OH group of donors (GO:0016614)](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/GTerm?id=GO:0016614)' via the presence of IPR022674

IPR022674  "represents the NAD-binding domain of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase" so I don't think it should be annotated with the catalytic term.
title: InterPro2GO issue: IPR022674 Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase, NAD-binding

author: tony787
body:
Hi Steven,
I have removed the term from this entry since there is a pseudo enzyme hit.
Residues from this domain, however, contribute to the activity and sculpting the active site.
Changes will be visible in the next InterPro release.
Best wishes,
Toni
